items.source: formatter - the formatter to add
items.translation: formatter - 要添加的格式化器

items.source: fieldType - the field type to format
items.translation: fieldType - 要格式化的字段类型

items.source: On print, if the Formatter's type T is declared and fieldType is not assignable to T, a coercion to T will be attempted before delegating to formatter to print a field value. On parse, if the parsed object returned by formatter is not assignable to the runtime field type, a coercion to the field type will be attempted before returning the parsed field value.
items.translation: 在打印时，如果 Formatter 的类型 T 已声明且 `fieldType` 不可赋值给 T，则在委托给 `formatter` 打印字段值之前，将尝试将其强制转换为 T。在解析时，如果 `formatter` 返回的解析对象不可赋值于运行时字段类型，则在返回解析的字段值之前，将尝试将其强制转换为字段类型。

items.source: On print, if the Printer's type T is declared and fieldType is not assignable to T, a coercion to T will be attempted before delegating to printer to print a field value. On parse, if the object returned by the Parser is not assignable to the runtime field type, a coercion to the field type will be attempted before returning the parsed field value.
items.translation: 在打印时，如果声明了 Printer 的类型 T 且 fieldType 不可赋值给 T，则在委托给 printer 打印字段值之前，将尝试将其强制转换为 T。在解析时，如果 Parser 返回的对象不可赋值于运行时字段类型，则在返回解析后的字段值之前，将尝试将其强制转换为字段类型。

items.source: Adds a Formatter to format fields annotated with a specific format annotation.
items.translation: 添加一个 Formatter，用于格式化带有特定格式注解的字段。

items.source:
Adds a Printer to print fields of a specific type.
The field type is implied by the parameterized Printer instance.
items.translation: 添加一个用于打印特定类型字段的打印机。字段类型由参数化的打印机实例隐含指定。

items.source:
Adds a Parser to parse fields of a specific type.
The field type is implied by the parameterized Parser instance.
items.translation: 添加一个用于解析特定类型字段的 Parser。字段类型由参数化的 Parser 实例隐式指定。
